## How it was checked

- [ ] `cargo xtask ci` passes locally (or explain what you couldn't run)
- [ ] every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`, see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] tests or a governance check cover the change; the governance suite stays at 100%
- [ ] docs updated (`docs/`), and `api/openapi.json` regenerated if the API changed
- [ ] no breaking change to the API, the Memory Format or the configuration, or it is labelled `breaking-change`
